title: Blush Framework region
description: A site region in user/data/regions/, shown by the theme location with the same name.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors check this file with.

items.description: What the region shows, in order. They replace the theme's items; an empty list clears them.

anyOf.description: What the region shows, in order. They replace the theme's items; an empty list clears them.

regionItem.description: One thing a region shows. An item is one kind: component, entry, markdown, view.

component.description: Shows a component, such as menu or acme/card. The item's other keys are its props.

entry.description: Shows an entry's content, as {type}/{key}, such as page/_regions/about.

markdown.description: Shows Markdown text, with components, or a map of locales to it.

view.description: Shows a template part from the site or theme, such as parts/newsletter. The item's other keys are its data.

localeText.description: Text by locale, such as {"en": "About", "fr": "À propos"}.
